prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates overall (RMSE=80.89) with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and excellent seasonality (0.9928), while FT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.9942). Extreme RMSE spread (15.93) and high seasonality variance warrant STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination. Trend is consistently downward across both folds with strength 254-322.
